label: Straight Welt 2.7 cm
description: A 2.7 cm straight welt is a deliberately wider reading of the English breast pocket, giving the chest a slightly bolder, more pronounced horizontal accent. It is often chosen on roomy hopsack or tweed sport jackets where a thicker welt is proportionally in keeping with a more textured cloth. The opening is left completely empty so the 2.7 cm depth reads at a glance, the welt standing as a single clean horizontal band across the chest.
